Is there a fee for the first meeting?
No. The first meeting, up to 30 minutes at the office or by video call, carries no fee and no obligation to engage.
Which courts do you appear before?
The High Court of Uttarakhand at Nainital, the Delhi High Court, the NCLAT, the Central Administrative Tribunal and the Supreme Court.

Can you take over a case that is already filed?
Yes. Bring the case number and copies of the last order. A no-objection from the previous counsel is usually needed to change the vakalatnama.
Why does this site not list past cases or client reviews?

The Bar Council of India's rules do not permit advocates to advertise, publicise the outcomes of cases or publish client testimonials. This website therefore gives only factual information: the courts she appears before, areas of practice, office details and how to arrange a meeting.

How do I check the status of my case at the Uttarakhand High Court?

Case status can be searched on the eCourts High Court services portal by case type, number and year, by party name or by advocate name. The daily cause list and orders are on the High Court's own website.
